_comment: Tunable scorer config. autoresearch mutates ONE field per iteration and keeps on train-agreement gain. Iteration 0 reproduces the live two-gate scoring so every gain is attributable. composite_weights mirror rubric.md (Scorecard B); substance_weight 0.5 mirrors the combined-loop objective (0.5*substance + 0.5*composite); tier_cutoffs start at the rubric's own Standard(50)/Viral(85) boundaries. See references/methodology.md.
